_comment: Sample MCP configuration for an ENCORE project (Module 4).
Copy to <project>/.mcp.json for Claude Code, or merge the mcpServers block into claude_desktop_config.json / your client's MCP config.
Remove this _comment key if your client rejects unknown keys.
Paths are relative to the project root. Secrets come from environment variables via ${VAR}; never put literal keys here.
encore-docs-readonly: the reference filesystem server also has write tools, so read-only is enforced by a Docker ':ro' mount and no network.
pathway-lookup: the custom FastMCP server from the Module 4 README (GET requests to the public Reactome API only).
lab-metadata-api: a lab-internal REST service exposed over Streamable HTTP on localhost; use a token with read-only scope.
web-fetch: fetches public web pages as markdown. Fetched content is untrusted input (prompt-injection risk).
Pin versions in real use (e.g. mcp-server-fetch==<version>, mcp/filesystem:<tag>).
Windows: ${PWD} is usually not defined there; replace it with the absolute project path (e.g. C:/Projects/my-encore-project).
